shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright stone monument
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow relief on an upright stone block and both include rounded disc/oval motifs and curving scroll-like forms, but that correspondence is generic. A depicts a fully realized standing human figure with elaborate headdress, ear ornaments, pectoral, belt and skirt panels rendered in dense, finely detailed relief, while B shows only a few large, crude, isolated ovals and circles with no discernible figure, costume or ordered composition.
